Annotators rated visual grounding on a four-point Likert scale: 1 (contradictory or irrelevant), 2 (many errors but still describes image), 3 (almost perfect with minor errors), 4 (perfect, no errors). For abstraction, annotators ranked six captions per image by increasing abstraction: original caption and one creative caption per degree (d=1 to d=5).
